_doc: Crafting stations (docs/PLAYER_SYSTEMS.md §4). kind gates recipes; grade (0-100) feeds item quality; owner (an npc key, or "" for anyone's) decides leave through their soul; fuel is what a craft burns from the owner's store. The player's own campfires and workbenches are built in the world and saved by Crafting, not listed here.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.unlocks: wood tools, bows, arrows, shields, leather, repairs

forge.name: Forge and anvil
forge.unlocks: smelting, steel, blades, armour, tools, re-forging

stations.name: Bjorn's forge
stations.ask: The stranger asks to work Bjorn's forge and anvil, burning his charcoal.

stations.name: Bjorn's bench
stations.ask: The stranger asks to use the bench at the back of Bjorn's forge.

stations.name: The Greystone smelter
stations.ask: The stranger asks to use the mine's smelter and anvil.

stations.name: Fort Ashguard's armoury forge
stations.ask: The stranger asks to work the garrison's armoury forge.

stations.name: Old Maud's herb table
stations.note: Maud keeps an open door for anyone who comes to heal; she has no soul file, so her table needs no leave.

stations.name: The abbey still
stations.ask: The stranger asks to use the abbey's herb table and still.

stations.name: The Cathedral infirmary
stations.ask: The stranger asks to use the infirmary's herb table.

stations.name: The waystation yard fire
stations.ask: The stranger asks to cook at the yard fire behind the waystation.
